input: Find summer programs and camps specifically for teens and middle schoolers for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville teen summer camp 2026 middle school
Asheville teen summer 2026 camp pottery theatre

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 Teen Day Camp served rising grades 6–9 with projects, service and field trips; 2027 details expected February 1.

candidates.name: UNC Asheville
candidates.note: Residential high-school pre-college programs, athletics camps and SkillSet maker camps; 2026 SkillSet sessions included ages 11–17.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: 2026 COMPASS residential immersion offered high-school tracks including cybersecurity, graphic design, creative writing and exercise science.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Summer Clubs and weeklong youth conferences; 2027 youth conferences announced for June–August.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Adventure Camp has tween ages 9–11 and teen ages 12–15 groups at Beaverdam and Enka-district locations.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: 2026 music camps served ages 4–18, including rock, jazz, voice, video-game music and audio production.

candidates.name: We Rock Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 band-writing camp at ArtSpace centered girls, trans and gender-expansive youth; junior volunteer roles for ages 16–18.

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: 2026 age-grouped studio art camps included rising middle- and high-school students through grade 12.

candidates.name: TORCHED Jewelry and Metalsmithing
candidates.note: 2026 five-day art and metalsmithing camps for ages 9–13, including July and August sessions.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: 2026 wilderness day camps and a teen overnight program for ages 12–17 focused on tracking, survival and teamwork.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: 2026 Evergreen Summer Adventures included middle-school campers, enrichment classes and outdoor field trips.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 garden and nature camps served grades K–10, with herbs, wildlife, fungi and outdoor-skills themes.

candidates.name: Cultivate Climbing
candidates.note: Weeklong summer climbing camps at Foundy Street served ages 6–14 with instruction, games and creative activities.

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 summer offerings included Adventure Camps and Kolo Bike Park mountain-bike camps.

candidates.name: Higher Ground Adventures
candidates.note: July 12–18, 2026 residential camp for youth of Black Mountain Home for Children; listed teen ages 13–18.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers grade-grouped summer programs through grade 12; upcoming-season registration includes a December 2026 discount deadline.

candidates.name: Young Life — Windy Gap
candidates.note: Residential summer camp specifically for middle- and high-school students.

candidates.name: Town of Black Mountain Recreation & Parks
candidates.note: Summer day camp includes rising sixth graders alongside younger children, with arts, STEM and area exploration.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2026 summer arts lineup included programs for children and teens; age ranges vary by session.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Theatre
candidates.note: Tanglewood Summer theatre camp; confirm the upcoming session’s middle-school and teen age eligibility.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camps offered sports, skills and academic reinforcement; grades vary by camp.
